dedupe_keys.name: irish cargo and tanker vessel density

description: Irish cargo and tanker vessel density provides an Irish-portal cargo and tanker vessel-density layer derived from EMODnet mapping. The provider is Marine Institute. Geographical and temporal coverage: The metadata identify Cogea's 2019 EU density maps and Marine Institute data provision. The linked provider page supplies the access route and documentation; the resource payload was not retrieved. Licence: CC-BY-4.0, read from the portal's dataset metadata on 2026-09-27; obtaining it is free of charge. Caveats: The page establishes existence and purpose, but neither completeness nor fitness for a particular simulation was independently tested. For simulation, the documented contents can support transport network modelling and capacity planning. This use is an interpretation of the metadata, not a tested integration. No directly related existing catalogue record was established.
